digest.title: Nvidia hardware worth $11.4M vanished between Oakland and Texas
digest.tldr: 6 pallets of hardware vanished en route to Texas, with no arrests 2 months later.

digest.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
digest.tldr: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company's H200 AI chips.

digest.title: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI finds 81 Firefox flaws, 948 Linux bugs
digest.tldr: OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new artificial intelligence model that has discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.

digest.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
digest.tldr: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

digest.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
